arStrings.szText: "The device led me to a relic containing Astaroth's blood."
So that’s why the demons swarmed Eldhaime. They were drawn to Astaroth's blood—and contorted by its power.
See, his fires raged on even after he was sealed. They sprouted from his ever-burning blood. Scosglen continued to smolder—until Donan doused the blood-flames.
Only, it seems he didn’t. I’d bet he used this device to gather it up. Hid it under the keep, slapped down his wards, and called it a day. Another Horadric half-measure.
You still have that blood relic? Look, there’s a slot on the device. Perhaps they fit together.
